$comment: Source of truth for the positional 'layer' model groups added to the xLights
The show folder itself ships as a binary .zip, so this file exists to keep the
change reviewable and machine-checkable. tools/xlights_layers.py writes these
groups into tesla_xlights_show_folder/xlights_rgbeffects.xml inside the zip and
verifies (in CI) that the zip still matches this file.
Model groups are a sequencer-side construct only: they reference existing models
by name and never define channels of their own. Adding them therefore cannot
change the generated .fseq channel layout. That is enforced separately by
Cybertruck models that exist purely so the 3D layout can show a second
vehicle. Each one deliberately reuses another model's StartChannel, so it
must never appear in a timeline group -- doing so would drive one channel
from two rows. Most are named with a 'CT ' prefix; 'Powered Frunk' is the
one that is not (it shadows 'Liftgate'), hence the explicit list.
tools/xlights_layers.py verifies that every name here really does share a
StartChannel with a model outside this set.

groups.name: LAYER Front Left
groups.comment: Every front-left exterior light. Together with 'LAYER Front Right' this is an exact partition of the existing 'Front' group.

groups.name: LAYER Rear Left
groups.comment: Rear-left exterior lights. Side repeaters are classed as rear to match the existing 'Rear' group.

groups.name: LAYER Rear Center
groups.comment: Rear lights that have no independent left/right control. 'LAYER Rear Left' + 'LAYER Rear Right' + this is an exact partition of the existing 'Rear' group.

groups.name: LAYER Left Side
groups.comment: Everything down the left flank, including the Cybertruck light bar segments. Built from the corner layers so there is a single definition of 'left'.

groups.name: LAYER All Doors
groups.comment: Front doors and falcon doors. Requested by name in issue #11.

groups.name: LAYER All Closures
groups.comment: Every moving closure. Built from existing groups so it stays correct if those change.

comment: Rows shown by the 'Layer View' timeline view. Chosen so that the rows are
mutually exclusive and together cover every channel the vehicle exposes,
so an effect placed on one row can never fight an effect on another.
The coarser 'LAYER Left Side' / 'LAYER Right Side' / 'LAYER All Closures'
groups overlap these rows by design and so are deliberately not listed;
they are still available from the Layout tab and from custom views.
